why: Optical shops sell glasses with lens types, prescriptions and fitting. Each pair is tracked by prescription and lens specification. The key is lens catalog, prescription linking and fitting notes.
operator: The optical shop owner manages a frame inventory, lens types and client prescriptions. Their day is eye tests (recorded), frame selection, lens ordering and fitting notes.
entities: Shop (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
Frame (id, shopId, nameAr, nameEn, brand, pricePiasters, costPiasters, taxRate, size, color, status, locationShelf)
LensType (id, shopId, nameAr, nameEn, index, coating (antiReflective,UV,photochromic), pricePiasters, costPiasters)
Prescription (id, clientName, clientPhone, sphere, cylinder, axis, add, pupillaryDistance, notes, validUntil, hasAstigmatism)
Order (id, shopId, frameId, lensTypeId, clientPrescriptionId, totalPiasters, depositPiasters, balancePiasters, status, readyDate, notes)
Client (id, shopId, name, phone, visitCount, totalSpentPiasters, lastVisit, notes)
Staff (id, shopId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
batches: No : optical shop carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Prescriptions have validUntil dates, frames have no expiry
special: The core structures are the frame inventory, lens type catalog, prescription per client and the order with deposit and balance. Prescription validity and lens fitting are the key differentiators.
screens: Frame catalogue: grid of frames with name, brand, price, size, color, availability badge
Frame detail: full info, supplier, reorder point, try-virtual (optional)
Lens type catalogue: list of lens types with index, coating, price, cost
Prescription editor: enter sphere, cylinder, axis, add, pupillary distance, validUntil, astigmatism flag, save per client
Order creation: select frame, select lens type, select prescription, compute total (frame + lenses), set deposit and balance, set status (draft/confirmed/in-progress/ready/ready-for-pickup)
Client profile: visit count, total spent, last visit, prescription history
Order status tracker: per order view progress (draft→confirmed→in-progress→ready→ready-for-pickup), print ready notice
Cash register: scan frame or order reference, record payment, print receipt
roles: Owner: everything : frames, lenses, prescriptions, orders, reports, billing
Optician: create prescriptions, select lens types, approve orders, fit frames
Sales rep: manage frames, create orders, client quotes
Cashier: scan frames/orders, tender payment, print receipt
reports: Frame sales by model and period: count per model/brand per month, revenue per model
Lens type performance: which lens types sell most, revenue per lens type per period
Prescription volume per optician: how many prescriptions per optician per period
Order pipeline: orders by status (draft/confirmed/in-progress/ready/ready-for-pickup) per period
Client repeat rate: visit count per client, total spent per client, re-book rate
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and order ready notices
WhatsApp deep link for ready-notice to client and prescription copy (opt-in)
Email for prescription copy and order updates (opt-in)
onboarding: Shop basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial frame inventory: the starting list of frames with SKU, brand, price and size
Lens type scheme: the lens types the shop carries with index, coating and pricing
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: receive first frame stock, first lens type, first prescription, first order
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the frame/lens/prescription schema and role templates.

tasks.title: Add frame catalogue with availability badge
tasks.brief: Build the frame catalogue: grid of frames with name, brand, price, size, color, availability badge. Done when the catalogue loads and displays frames with correct availability badges.
tasks.done: When frame catalogue displays live data with availability badges

tasks.title: Add lens type catalogue
tasks.brief: Build the lens type catalogue: list of lens types with index, coating, price, cost. Done when the catalogue loads and displays lens types correctly.
tasks.done: When lens type catalogue displays live data

tasks.title: Add prescription editor per client
tasks.brief: Build the prescription screen: sphere, cylinder, axis, add, pupillary distance, validUntil, astigmatism flag, save per client. Done when the prescription is saved and linked to a client.
tasks.done: When prescription editor works and saves per client

tasks.title: Add order creation with deposit and balance
tasks.brief: Build the order screen: select frame, lens type, prescription, compute total, set deposit and balance, set status. Done when the order saves all fields and status updates correctly.
tasks.done: When order creation works end-to-end with deposit and balance

tasks.title: Add client profile with prescription history
tasks.brief: Build the client profile: visit count, total spent, last visit, prescription history. Done when the profile saves and displays correct data.
tasks.done: When client profile works and displays live data with prescription history

tasks.title: Add order status tracker with pipeline
tasks.brief: Build the order tracker: per order view progress (draft/confirmed/in-progress/ready/ready-for-pickup), print ready notice. Done when the tracker updates status and prints ready notice correctly.
tasks.done: When order status tracker works end-to-end with pipeline and receipt printing

tasks.title: Add cash register with frame/Order scanning
tasks.brief: Build the cash register: scan frame or order reference, record payment, print receipt. Done when the sale records correctly and receipt prints.
tasks.done: When cash register works end-to-end and receipt prints correctly

tasks.title: Add frame sales by model report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing count per model/brand per month and revenue per model. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When frame sales report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add lens type performance report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing which lens types sell most and revenue per lens type per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When lens type performance report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add prescription volume per optician report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing how many prescriptions per optician per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When prescription volume report computes correctly from live data

risks: Encryption key loss makes frame and prescription records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Prescription validity without clear validUntil can violate consumer protection law
Fitting claims without proper optician certification can raise liability issues
